label: Sad
acknowledgment: Sadness is not a flaw. The Quran speaks to it with gentleness. These words have comforted hearts for 1400 years. They are here for you today.

verses.translation_en: Do not grieve; indeed Allah is with us.
verses.context: Said in the cave of Thawr, when the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ and Abu Bakr were hiding. The pursuers were at the entrance.

verses.translation_en: For indeed, with hardship comes ease.
verses.context: The Arabic places ease with hardship, not after it. They are intertwined.

verses.translation_en: Your Lord has not forsaken you, nor has He become displeased.
verses.context: Revealed when the Prophet ﷺ had not received revelation for some time, and the disbelievers mocked him.

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا أَشْكُو بَثِّي وَحُزْنِي إِلَى اللَّهِ
verses.translation_en: I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allah.
verses.context: Yaqub spoke these words after losing Yusuf. Grief was spoken, not suppressed.

verses.translation_en: Do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
verses.context: No matter how far you feel, His mercy is wider.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَهِنُوا وَلَا تَحْزَنُوا وَأَنتُمُ الْأَعْلَوْنَ
verses.translation_en: And do not weaken and do not grieve, for you will be superior.
verses.context: Strength and elevation are placed beside the command against grief.

verses.translation_en: And give good tidings to the patient.
verses.context: The verses that follow name the blessings, mercy, and guidance given to them.

verses.arabic: لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا
verses.translation_en: Allah does not burden a soul beyond that it can bear.
verses.context: The burden is measured by the soul's widest capacity.

verses.arabic: أَلَا إِنَّ أَوْلِيَاءَ اللَّهِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
verses.translation_en: Unquestionably, for the allies of Allah there will be no fear, nor will they grieve.
verses.context: A promise given to those who stay close to Him.

verses.translation_en: And what is with Allah is better and more lasting.
verses.context: What is with Allah is better and more lasting than the present.

names_of_allah.explanation: He preserves what you cannot protect. Your peace, your future, your loved ones. Nothing is lost with Him.

evidence_verses.arabic: إِنَّ رَبِّي عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ حَفِيظٌ
evidence_verses.translation_en: Indeed, my Lord is, over all things, a Preserver.
And your Lord is, over all things, a Preserver.

names_of_allah.explanation: His mercy is not a reward for the deserving. It is the air you are already breathing. It does not run out.

evidence_verses.translation_en: The Most Compassionate, taught the Quran.
Do not despair of the mercy of Allah.

names_of_allah.explanation: He does not rush. He waits. He gives time for return. His patience is a door held open.

evidence_verses.translation_en: And Allah is Forgiving and Forbearing.
Indeed, He is ever Forbearing and Forgiving.

names_of_allah.explanation: He responds. Not always in the way we expect. Not always in the time we choose. But He responds.

evidence_verses.translation_en: Indeed, my Lord is Near and Responsive.
Call upon Me; I will respond to you.

names_of_allah.explanation: He is closer than your own jugular vein. Closeness is stated without condition, without distance, without delay.

evidence_verses.arabic: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ
evidence_verses.translation_en: And when My servants ask you concerning Me, indeed I am near.

evidence_verses.arabic: وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ الْوَرِيدِ
evidence_verses.translation_en: And We are closer to him than his jugular vein.

personal_question: Where do you take your grief? To people, or to Allah?
